scope: sampled visual and story review; ASR and measured signal support; no validated audio listening
product_from_film: Omi for macOS is presented as an assistant that observes on-screen context, gives advice and helps with actions.
explains_well: The final replay points back to a briefly visible person in a video call, giving the memory claim a concrete story payoff.
unclear: The film does not explain observation controls, what is stored or when an action needs confirmation.
scenario: Check a social claim, resume an email task, recall a video-call detail and help order food.
product_clear_basis: A contextual tip appears beside the social feed, followed by evidence cards.

scenes.action: A man on a video call stands to fetch something; another person is briefly visible behind the caller. After a black sample, he reaches toward the camera and sits alone.
scenes.design: Fixed wide desktop-facing camera with translucent call overlay.

scenes.action: A social feed appears at left with a sensational identity claim. A right-side tip disputes it and evidence cards appear. A focus prompt tells the man to return to emailing his boss.
scenes.design: Feed, contextual tip, evidence cards and focus notification around the person.
scenes.evidence: Visible chronological 1 fps samples, source 8–21s; boundary approximate; exact motion between samples unverified.

scenes.action: An email composer replaces the feed. A Don’t apologize tip appears as the draft changes, then the composer shrinks away and the man leans back.

scenes.evidence: Visible chronological 1 fps samples, source 21–34s; boundary approximate; exact motion between samples unverified.

scenes.action: A Maya call label appears, then a video call. The man and caller exchange expressions while he remains seated.

scenes.action: The man leaves his seat and returns with a blue portrait painting. Another person is briefly visible behind the caller. The call ends; he puts the painting down and a tip says it was thoughtful.
scenes.design: Physical prop and repeated call-background detail.
scenes.purpose: Build a personal disappointment and show contextual reassurance.
scenes.evidence: Visible chronological 1 fps samples, source 60–80s; boundary approximate; exact motion between samples unverified.

scenes.action: An Ordering Thai Food for Maya action appears, followed by a question about ordering for two. A large replay panel opens, shows the earlier call and enlarges the person in its background.
scenes.design: Action cards, video replay timeline and a growing crop.
scenes.purpose: Demonstrate recall of a missed detail; the relationship implication is narrative, not established fact.
scenes.evidence: Visible chronological 1 fps samples, source 80–101s; boundary approximate; exact motion between samples unverified.

scenes.action: The replay leaves and the man reacts in the held room shot. Omi closes on black with For macOS. It sees everything. and omi.me/macos.
scenes.design: Human reaction followed by bold white wordmark.
scenes.purpose: Land the story twist and name the product.
scenes.evidence: Visible chronological 1 fps samples, source 101–114.28s; boundary approximate; exact motion between samples unverified.

lessons.keep: Plant a visible detail and return to its source at the moment it becomes useful.
lessons.avoid: Avoid turning an observed detail into an unsupported personal conclusion.
lessons.open: Observation controls, stored context, evidence quality, action approval, food-order completion and all audio remain unverified.
try: Show Tin recalling an earlier campaign constraint with the exact brief excerpt beside the draft.
Add a clear confirmation card before an assistant publishes or orders anything in the story.
